title: Ellis long-handle bag
description:
Ellis pairs a rounded rectangular body with long twin handles and a softly pebbled finish. A curved zip opening follows its upper edge, while the uncluttered front keeps the shape understated. Choose Black or Brown for an easy companion to everyday layers.

A zippered inner pocket, phone pocket and card pocket give smaller belongings their own place. The long handles offer an easy way to carry it through the day.

care: General guidance for the leather exterior, not product-specific manufacturer instructions. Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight, heaters and damp storage. If wet, let the leather dry naturally away from heat. Do not machine wash or use household cleaners. Identify the finish before using a treatment; use only a suitable product and test an unseen area first. For stains or an unknown finish, consult a leather-care specialist. Follow any instructions supplied with your bag.
